title: Pandi Nattu Thangam
desc: A village chief and his father, who control the village activities besides smuggling sandalwood, create problems for a forest officer, Thangapandian, and a fellow villager, Radha.

title: Muppozhudhum Un Karpanaigal
desc: A man falls in love with a girl with a mysterious past. However, her true identity is revealed when the man has an accident.

title: Priyasakhi
desc: Sandhana Krishnan falls in love with Priya, a model. However, the couple strive to navigate challenges, as they come from contrasting families.

title: Kaaval
desc: Anbu saves the life of his gangster friend, Karuna, from a police officer. However, a sudden turn of events leaves him running for survival when both the police and Karuna turn against him.

title: Yennai Arindhaal
desc: Sathyadev, an honest police officer, is on a mission to stop an organ trafficking racket, unaware that the mastermind is the same person who killed his beloved.
